name: Discipline
summary: In Tirisfal Glades, Executor Zygand calls on outsiders to keep the Deathguard alert. He trusts his garrison little and orders punishment for sentries who slacken.

sections.title: Enforcing Order in Undeath
sections.body: The Deathguard guard the Forsaken across Lordaeron. Freedom from the Lich King's control has brought apathy, fatigue, and neglect. Yet the Scarlet Crusade and Scourge prowl Tirisfal's borders, so the garrison must stay ready. Executor Zygand has little patience for sentries who let their discipline slip. The officers use force and close oversight to keep their troops alert.

sections.title: The Executor's Ledger
sections.body: Executor Zygand chooses outsiders to punish negligent Deathguards instead of using soldiers from his own garrison. With the Executor's Motivator, you remind the sentries that service to the Dark Lady demands constant vigilance. Even in undeath, they face the consequences of neglecting their duties.

faq.answer: Executor Zygand gives the order in Tirisfal Glades. He oversees the region's defenses and demands obedience from his troops.

faq.q: Why does Executor Zygand want the Deathguard punished?
faq.answer: Zygand considers his Deathguards incompetent and lacking drive. He believes their complacency endangers the Forsaken in Tirisfal, so he uses harsh punishment to rouse them.

faq.q: Why does Zygand use an adventurer instead of another soldier?
faq.answer: Zygand says you have not yet joined the Deathguard. You have not had the chance to disappoint him.
The Executor's Motivator is a disciplinary tool Zygand gives you to punish idle Deathguards stationed across Tirisfal Glades.

faq.q: What happens if you refuse Zygand's order?
faq.answer: Zygand warns that if you hesitate or refuse, he will enter your name in his ledger. Then he will send someone else to discipline you.

faq.q: How do the Forsaken view pain?
faq.answer: Zygand counts pain among the few pleasures still open to him in death. His delight in punishment reflects his harsh nature.

angles.text: For the Forsaken, discipline means survival. Sentries who give in to apathy put all of Tirisfal Glades at risk.
Forsaken commanders use grim methods. Their ways reflect the harsh rule of the Horde's northern lands.
